# Export formats

| Format | Written as |
|---|---|
| `sav` | SPSS |
| `zsav` | SPSS, compressed |
| `dta` | Stata |
| `csv` | CSV (UTF-8) |
| `xlsx` | Excel |

## Stata releases

| `dta_version` | Readable by | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `13` | Stata 13 (format 117) |  |
| `14` | Stata 14-18 (format 118) | yes |
| `15` | Stata 15-18, over 32,767 variables (format 119) |  |

## Options

- Value labels (`value_label_mode`): `labels`, `strings`, `none`.
- Declared missing codes (`missing_code_mode`): `as_missing`, `keep_codes`.
